rachel: Quick one99Client: AeroNova reports a billing credit didn't reflect. Invoice INV-2026-0998 shows usage 420k tokens, billed $210. They say a $150 trial credit should have applied.
elainE: small typo there, tagging @elaine
elaiNe: (oops)
elainE: I'm going to step back.
elainE: Wait ignore me.
elainE: Sorry wrong channel.
elainE: Also there's noise.
elainE: I'll focus.
elainE: LOL
elainE: This is getting silly.
elainE: Back to thread.
elainE: okay thanks
elaine: Looking now. Account shows trial credit consumed earlier on a different invoice cycle; the $150 trial was auto-applied to INV-2026-0944 on 2026-02-12. 
omar: Confirmed, trial credit already used. But customer says it should have stacked with a one-time onboarding credit of $100. Onboarding credit didn't apply due to promo stacking rule.
rachel: Customer attached screenshot where support noted onboarding promo. Can we make a goodwill exception?
elaine: I can approve up to $250 for first-touch mistakes. Requested goodwill = $100. Approved.
omar: Creating manual credit:
```
# apply onboarding goodwill credit
billingctl credit --customer AERON-33 --invoice INV-2026-0998 --amount 100.00 --currency USD --reason "goodwill: onboarding_missed"
```
billing-bot: Credit created: cr_1P4bZx5L, amount $100.00, status: pending.
 rachel: I'll notify the customer and attach the corrected invoice.
elaine: Please add REF-2026-321 to the ledger and include note about non-stackable promo flag.
omar: Done. Marking for March adjustments reconciliation.
rachel: Customer replied, thanks. Closing thread."
